settings.title: Settings
settings.explanation: UniLibrary is off by default. While it is off, nothing from UniLibrary shows anywhere in the library: no source chip, no filter, no cards, no “More from UniLibrary”, and the server makes no calls to it.
settings.enableHint: Show UniLibrary cards in search and on item pages. Readers open the books on UniLibrary itself.
settings.anonymousHint: Let visitors who are not signed in see UniLibrary cards too. It works only while UniLibrary is enabled.

breakerHint.closed: Calls go to UniLibrary as usual.
breakerHint.open: Too many calls failed. Saved results are shown for a minute before it tries again.
breakerHint.half_open: One test call is going through to see if UniLibrary is back.

coming.title: Feeds and mapping are coming.
coming.text: Periodic feeds and the subject-to-field mapping are not part of this version. Search on demand works as soon as UniLibrary is enabled.

sanctions.title: Warnings and upload bans
sanctions.description: After upheld reports, warn a user or ban them from uploading. The decision is audited and the user sees it.
sanctions.userIdHint: The id from the user's page in Users and roles.
sanctions.userIdInvalid: Enter the user id as a UUID, for example 0b8e6a52-6f4e-4a62-9e0f-5a1d3c2b4e7f.
sanctions.untilHint: Leave it empty for a ban without an end date.
sanctions.reasonHint: The user will see this text.

import.hint: Drop a CSV file here or choose it.

import.errors: {count, plural, one {# row has an error and was skipped.} other {# rows have errors and were skipped.}}

rights.title: Rights
rights.intro: A book cannot be published without a rights class and the basis for it.

public_domain.label: Public domain
public_domain.hint: The author died more than 70 years ago, or an anonymous work was first published more than 50 years ago, or an official document or folklore.

open_license.label: Open licence
open_license.hint: CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, CC0 and similar.

permission.label: Permission of the rights holder
permission.hint: The rights holder allows the lyceum to host it. Lyceum only.

official.label: Official textbook
official.hint: A textbook of the ministry or a state publisher with a documented basis. Lyceum only.

basis.label: How is it free?
basis.anonymous: Anonymous work: year of first publication

rights.ruleHint: For example: the author died in 1938, so the work is free from 1 January 2009.
rights.licenceHint: Choose from the list or type the code, for example CC BY-SA 4.0.
rights.sourceUrlHint: The page at the source that shows the licence.
rights.attributionHint: Shown with the book, as the licence requires.
rights.proofHint: Upload the written permission (a PDF or a photo).
rights.proofOnFile: A proof of permission is on file.
rights.scopeHint: What the rights holder allows, for example hosting for lyceum members.
rights.expiryHint: A reminder is sent 60 days before.
rights.referenceHint: The order of the ministry or the publisher's permission.

visibility.label: Who can see the book
visibility.lyceumOnly: This rights class can only be shown to lyceum users.
visibility.downloadHint: Readers may save the file. Follow the permission or the basis.
